title: Robot vacuum with a smiling face
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- floor shadow -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='82' rx='36' ry='7' fill='#2b3a55'/>
  <!-- body: round disc vacuum -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='66' rx='34' ry='20' fill='#4f7fd6'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='62' rx='34' ry='20' fill='#6f9ef0'/>
  <!-- top plate -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='60' rx='26' ry='14' fill='#a9c8ff'/>
  <!-- face screen -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='58' rx='19' ry='10' fill='#132038'/>
  <!-- eyes -->
  <circle cx='43' cy='56' r='3.2' fill='#5ff2c4'/>
  <circle cx='57' cy='56' r='3.2' fill='#5ff2c4'/>
  <!-- smile -->
  <path d='M42 62 Q50 69 58 62' stroke='#5ff2c4' stroke-width='2.6' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- bumper front -->
  <path d='M22 68 Q50 88 78 68' stroke='#8fd0ff' stroke-width='4' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- side brush -->
  <g stroke='#ffd166' stroke-width='3' stroke-linecap='round'>
    <line x1='18' y1='74' x2='10' y2='70'/>
    <line x1='18' y1='74' x2='12' y2='80'/>
    <line x1='18' y1='74' x2='8' y2='77'/>
  </g>
  <circle cx='18' cy='74' r='3' fill='#f4a641'/>
  <!-- power button -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='48' r='3.4' fill='#ff6f91'/>
  <!-- little antenna light -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='44' r='1.6' fill='#5ff2c4'/>
</svg>
